title: 3.05 / Typography / Open Sans
slide_intent: Adapt a type system to its medium so reading quality and availability remain dependable.
strategic_value: A named web substitute can keep Spectrum’s digital communications consistent when print families are replaced.
demonstration: Open Sans characters and five roman/italic weight pairs follow a web-use explanation; Extrabold carries an accent-only note.
practical_value: Use the designated web family and avoid treating the heaviest weight as a default headline.

content_islands.name: Heading and web role
content_islands.spec: Place the title upper left and web substitution explanation above the specimen, with download guidance to the right.

content_islands.spec: Align upright and italic weights below and retain the Extrabold restriction at right.

ingredient.name: Open Sans
ingredient.role: Provide a consistent web and mobile reading voice.
ingredient.application: Use Open Sans on the web in place of Gotham and Whitney. Reserve Extrabold for sparse accents, never headlines or body text.
ingredient.scope: Web applications described by the 2017 guide.
